description: Verify that DHCPREQUEST in RENEWING fills 'ciaddr' with the client's IP address (RFC 2131 §4.4.5)
approach:
[Objective]
In RENEWING the client is already bound; ciaddr advertises the bound IP so the server can match it to the existing lease. Setting it to 0 (REQUESTING-style) would make the server treat the message as a fresh REQUEST and likely NAK.

[Scenario — chronological]
1. DORA → BOUND with yiaddr = Y.
2. T1 → RENEWING → renew DHCPREQUEST
   • ciaddr == Y   ← key check

[Pass condition]
RENEWING REQUEST.ciaddr equals the bound client IP.

[Fail condition]
Any chain step missing OR Fail_renewing_request_ciaddr_mismatch — ciaddr is not the bound IP.

verdicts.Fail_no_discover: No DUT DHCPDISCOVER within the listen window
verdicts.Fail_no_renewing_request: No DUT renewing DHCPREQUEST within listen window
